title: 云南普洱：中国 98% 的咖啡都从这里来｜Yunnan Pu'er Coffee
description:
你喝过中国自己种的咖啡吗？浓而不苦的那一口，你会打几分？

你手里这杯咖啡，可能来自中国。云南种出了中国约 98% 的咖啡，单是普洱一个地方，就占了全国六成左右。清晨采下红果，指尖还沾着雾；豆子在晒床上翻晒，慢慢醒来。保山的小粒咖啡——浓而不苦，还带着微微的果酸。板扎！（云南话：极好）这就是山里给的答案。

The coffee in your hand may be grown in China. Yunnan produces roughly 98% of the country's coffee, and Pu'er alone accounts for about 60% of national output. Pickers take the red cherries at dawn, mist still on their fingers; the beans dry slowly on raised beds. Baoshan's small-bean arabica is prized as bold-but-not-bitter, smooth, with a faint fruity acidity. In Yunnan they'd call that 板扎 (bǎnzā) — superb.

本片无旁白：以中英双语字幕叙述，配免版税音乐。/ No voiceover — narrated through bilingual subtitles over a royalty-free music bed (no AI narration in this video). 「板扎」为云南方言，片中已如实标注。
